It lists the four warning signs specific to panels, names the panel brands that get replaced rather than repaired (Federal Pacific Stab-Lok, Zinsco), explains that sizing comes from a load calculation, and gives a five-item checklist of what to read off the panel door before calling, so the first call already has the main breaker size, open slots and any tripped breakers.
